description: Phrase-level acoustic error correction rules. Rules MUST include local phonetic context to avoid false-positive substring replacement.

rules.pattern: お味噌の(ちんぽ|チンポ|おちんちん)
rules.note: Acoustic confusion: おじさん misheard as お味噌 when combined with penis terminology. Never replace naked お味噌.
Acoustic confusion: なかだし misheard as なかよし in climax/sex contexts.

learned_fixes.pattern: お味噌の(精液|ザーメン)
learned_fixes.note: Acoustic mishearing for uncle in semen context
